text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye got injured during training,
so I hurriedly carried her to the infirmary.
choice_data_list: You need strict bed rest for the rest of the day.
You need strict bed rest for today, okay?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: True. But even if it's 'absolute rest,' I'm against doing nothing at all.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Why don't we explore what we can do in this state?
Like trying out new training methods, perhaps?"
choice_data_list: No, let's lie down for now.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Even if you say that,
I can't just fall asleep in the middle of the day."
choice_data_list: Now, now, just think of resting as part of your training.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Mmh...
That's true, that is something we can do right now.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer.
Could you propose some concrete training details?

"And so, I made sure
to take proper care of Almond Eye."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Alright, off to the Trainer's office...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry... Could you lend me your shoulder for a bit?
The pain is worse than I thought...

Seeing Almond Eye grimace,
I hurriedly lent her a hand...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ah... that was 0.3 seconds too fast.
...And here I thought my internal clock
was fairly accurate.
choice_data_list: My heart rate's up from the hot spring, that's all.
My heart rate's up from the hot spring, you know.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I see... Things really can get out of whack
while running, so this is great training!

We found ways to make sure not to overdo it after that,
and safely brought the training session to an end.
